_doc: Owl v7.0 — operator-tunable config. Wallet/chatId/decision_model resolved from env vars at runtime install (${WALLET_ADDRESS}, ${TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID}, ${OWL_DECISION_MODEL}); do NOT hardcode here. Risk gates and asset cooldowns are enforced by the runtime via runtime.yaml and the producer's hardcoded constants.

tiers._note: max conviction — extreme funding + heavy SM tilt + high OI + strong exhaustion

marginPct._note: 25% of account value per slot. Override per-deploy via OWL_MARGIN_PCT env var.

crowding._note: Crowding score components: funding extremity (0-4), SM tilt (0-3, +1 if confirms funding), OI concentration (0-2). Persistence tolerance: 2 consecutive below-threshold scans (30 min at 15-min cadence) before clear, prevents single-noise-tick reset (v5.3 fix).

exhaustion._note: Exhaustion signals: volume declining (3pts), price stalling vs crowd direction (3pts), volume spike no follow-through (2pts), 4h RSI divergence (2pts). At least 2 distinct signals required to fire.

entry._note: Combined crowding + exhaustion score. Mirrors owl-producer.py hardcoded MIN_COMBINED_SCORE. Producer constants WIN — config is informational/audit only in v7.

universe._note: v6.1 universe expansion preserved — ALL crypto perps with OI > $3M (no top-30 truncation). XYZ commodities banned (different unwind dynamics, that's not Owl's lane).

dynamicDailyCap._note: Producer-side PnL-aware daily cap. Drawdown circuit breaker mirrors runtime.guard_rails.drawdown_halt_pct=25.

_runtime_owns._doc: These were v6.x concerns. In v7, the runtime owns them via runtime.yaml.guard_rails. DO NOT add gates here.
_runtime_owns.execution.entryOrderType: runtime.actions.owl_entry.params.order_type (FEE_OPTIMIZED_LIMIT, ensure_execution_as_taker:false — entries cancel-and-skip if maker can't fill)
_runtime_owns.execution.exitOrderType: runtime.exit.order_type (FEE_OPTIMIZED_LIMIT, ensure_execution_as_taker:true — exits use taker fallback as safety floor)
